On Friday, July 31, 2015 at 7:41:19 AM UTC-4, Sebastian Weber wrote:
As.mcmc.list

simply ignores the pars argument given... it always returns all parameters sampled. It would be nice to get the warmup optionally.
And just to make sure: The function resturn the samples in order as sampled in Stan? So it does make sense to look at traceplots and I should permute the order of samples before using this, right?

They are in order, but the (lack of) a permutation is only relevant if you are using fewer than all the draws to make an inference.

Ben
